svg.aria-label: Riemann construction and ATM replicating payoff for KXBTCD-26AUG0717
svg.text: the ATM call as an integral of 31 digitals, and as the stack of digitals that replicates it · expiry 2026-08-07 21:00 UTC
D(K) = Q(S > K) · area right of the strike = the call
payoff at expiry vs settlement price
every quoted strike in the 2%-98% CDF band
(13 strikes outside the band hidden; the panels above still use the full ladder)
left: the shaded area is C(K_atm) = int_K^inf D(u) du, ruled at every strike into the dK columns it is
summed from. The staircase above the curve is the left-hand sum (call_hi), the one below it the
right: dK digitals struck at each K_i super-replicate the call; the same widths struck one strike up
sub-replicate it. The gap between them is the strike grid. Each slab is one digital's dK, and they stack
past 72,000 the ladder stops: both stacks go flat, the payoff does not. That wedge is the tail model --
greeks: dC/dK is exact -- it is minus the digital quote at K, which this ladder prices directly, and its
slope-of-the-curve reading is the left panel. delta, gamma, vega and theta differentiate in F, sigma and
t, which one expiry cannot pin down, so they are Black-76 at this strike's own IV
warning: dropped 19 of 50 threshold strikes pinned at the extreme tick; integrating their midpoints
would have added ~$40 to every call. The region beyond the live quotes is the tail model's job now
warning: digital curve was not monotone; PAVA-repaired before integrating
